title: 第102章：打造一支神枪队
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着剧情推进，众人看得入了迷。

他们连泡面也忘了吃，恨不得钻进幕布里，替电影里的人去打仗。

秦昭岚看见打仗的画面，一开始还怕吓到苏安安，会抬手捂住苏安安的眼睛。

可看着看着，她盖在苏安安眼睛上的手，便缓缓垂了下来。

“这个大家伙是什么东西，怎么这么厉害，连枪都打不穿？”

“急死我了，真想一脚把这个铁疙瘩踹飞。”

听见秦昭岚在身边碎碎念，苏安安看向幕布上前的大家伙。

她记得这个东西，这是坦克。

她娘居然想把坦克踹飞，这对吗？

电影播了一个多时辰才结束，众人手中的泡面都冷了。

可他们都顾不上心疼，还沉浸在电影的情节里。

“好惨啊，死了好多人啊！”

“那里面的东西，怎么都那么厉害？刚开始，我以为枪就是最厉害的，没想到后面还有什么飞机、坦克的。”

“幸好咱们这里没有，不然两国打仗，会死更多的人！”

张老头摇摇头，心里有些庆幸。

苏安安听见他的话，将刚掏出来的手枪，重新放了回去。

她让大家看战争片，是为了让大家了解枪有多厉害。

可大家看完了，似乎很害怕枪的存在呀！

这可怎么办呢？

苏安安挠了挠小脑袋，心里犯了难。

这跟她请大家看电影的初衷，完全不一样！

算啦算啦，让大家先消化一晚上再说叭！

众人看完电影，帮忙把凳子和幕布收了起来。

夜里，苏安安睡得正香，突然被人一脚踢开。

她“哎哟”一声，从地上爬起来。

只见秦昭岚双眼紧闭，紧张地皱着眉头。

“他们有枪，安安快跑！”

娘亲这是梦见什么了呀？

苏安安揉着自己的屁股，可怜巴巴地躺了回去。

好在秦昭岚后半夜还算睡得安稳，没再将苏安安踢开。

第二日，苏安安吃完早饭，从帐篷里走出来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the plot progressed, everyone was fascinated.

They even forgot to eat instant noodles and wished they could get under the curtain and fight for the people in the movie.

When Qin Zhaolan saw the fighting scene, he was afraid of scaring Su Anan at first, so he would raise his hand to cover Su Anan's eyes.

But as she watched, her hand covering Su Anan's eyes slowly dropped.

"What is this big guy? Why is it so powerful that it can't even be penetrated by a gun?"

"I'm so anxious, I really want to kick this iron lump away."

Hearing Qin Zhaolan muttering beside her, Su Anan looked at the big guy coming up behind the curtain.

She remembered this thing, it was a tank.

Her mother actually wants to kick the tank away, is that right?

The movie ended after more than an hour, and the instant noodles in everyone's hands were cold.

But they couldn't care less about their heartache and were still immersed in the plot of the movie.

"It's so tragic, so many people died!"

"Why are the things in there so powerful? At first, I thought the guns were the most powerful, but I didn't expect there were planes and tanks behind them."

"Fortunately we don't have one here, otherwise more people would die in a war between the two countries!"

Old man Zhang shook his head, feeling a little lucky.

Su Anan heard what he said and put back the pistol he had just taken out.

She lets everyone watch war movies to let everyone know how powerful guns are.

But after reading it, everyone seems to be very afraid of the existence of guns!

What to do?

Su Anan scratched her little head, feeling troubled.

This is completely different from her original intention of inviting everyone to watch the movie!

Forget it, let everyone digest it overnight before talking!

After everyone finished watching the movie, they helped put away the stools and curtains.

At night, Su Anan was sleeping soundly when she was suddenly kicked away.

She said "ouch" and got up from the ground.

Qin Zhaolan's eyes were closed tightly and his brows were frowning nervously.

"They have guns, An'an, run!"

Mom, what are you dreaming about?

Su Anan rubbed her butt and lay back pitifully.

Fortunately, Qin Zhaolan slept peacefully for the rest of the night and did not kick Su Anan away again.

On the second day, Su Anan walked out of the tent after breakfast.
